record.content: The user-supplied pin resolves to a Google Maps place named Restroom at 37.5041895, -121.9081485 on the Ohlone Wilderness Trail near Stanford Avenue. Google categorizes it as a public bathroom and displays a wheelchair-accessible-entrance attribute. Community photos visibly show a fixed restroom structure and at least three portable toilet units. Gallery metadata exposes photos dated September 2021, March 2022, and July 2025 plus imagery captured January 2023; Google does not expose the pin creation date. A review displayed as one year old reports that this is the last restroom before the trailhead and that it has no handwashing place; this is community-reported rather than independently verified.
record.observer: Wayproof browser and visual source review
